_comment: An example engine configuration that reaches the adapters of this package.
Copy the two keys below into the engine configuration file: 'external_modules' loads the
package so its adapters register, and 'providers' names the seats a node's 'provider' field
resolves against. A provider name is free: it is what the workflow says, not what the adapter
is called. The credential is present as the name of an environment variable and never as a
value; a local server that needs none omits 'api_key_env' entirely.

options.system: You answer with the requested JSON object and nothing else.
